name: Celica Clayton
original_name: セリカ クレイトン
source:
"Bring it on! I'll crush you with one swing of my sword!

A young, fearless warrior better known by her alias, the Monarch Adventurer. Her skills on the battlefield are considered second-to-none. Her ultimate goal is to reach the gates of Odyssia, the mystical sky capital, and she is famous for being the only NPC to ever get close. Her charm and light-hearted humor make her a welcome addition to [url=/c84006]Shiina's[/url] party.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Chloe Aaron (クロエ・アーロン).[/spoiler]
